events.title: An Evening With Lucinda Williams and Her Band
events.description: Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter Lucinda Williams and her band will bring an unmistakable blend of rock, blues, folk and country to the Carolina Theatre at Belk Place on Saturday, Sept. 26. Showtime is 8 p.m. Doors open up at 7 p.m. One of America's most celebrated and influential songwriters, Williams has spent more than four decades crafting deeply personal songs that have earned widespread critical acclaim and inspired generations of artists. Known for timeless albums including Car Wheels on a Gravel Road, Essence and Good Souls Better Angels, Williams continues to captivate audiences with performances that are as powerful and authentic as ever. In January of this year, Williams released her sixteenth studio album, World?s Gone Wrong, led by singles ?The World?s Gone Wrong? and ?Something?s Gotta Give?.

events.title: 9 to 5 (1980 film) - Dolly Parton Appreciation Day
events.description: Join us at the Carolina Theatre as we celebrate Dolly Parton Appreciation Day with a special screening of the beloved comedy classic, "9 to 5." Starring Dolly Parton alongside Lily Tomlin and Jane Fonda, this laugh-out-loud workplace comedy follows three office employees who decide they've had enough of their overbearing boss and take matters into their own hands. Packed with sharp humor, unforgettable performances, and Dolly's iconic Grammy-winning title song, "9 to 5" remains just as funny and relevant today as it was when it premiered. Whether you're a lifelong Dolly fan or discovering this classic for the first time, come celebrate the wit, warmth, and unmistakable charm of one of America's most beloved entertainers. Grab your friends, sing along when that famous theme song starts, and spend an evening honoring the queen of rhinestones, big dreams, and bigger hairstyles. Runtime: 110 minutes Rated: PG

events.title: Dante Gebel - World Tour Despedida 2026
events.description: Doors 7pm. Show 8pm. World Tour Despedida 2026. "It's time for the farewell." After a historic world tour with over 700,000 live audiences, this conference is "a journey to the heart and soul." In this show, Dante Gebel shares stories that range from laughter to tears, addressing themes such as life, neighborhood, death, nostalgia, and everyday anecdotes that lead us to profound reflections of the soul. For two and a half hours, Dante skillfully performs stand-up comedy that, while employing humor, also confronts the deepest emotions with raw honesty as he blends laughter, tears, and a message straight to the heart.
